Elaine (CS): FYI AtlasOps flagged a month-end mismatch — their dashboard totals vs the invoice don't line up. Invoice shows a 'Pro Plus' line for Feb 28 that the dashboard never had.
Sam (Billing): can you paste the invoice snippet + customer id?
Elaine (CS): cust_AtlasOps123, attaching excerpt: 
```
Invoice #INV-2026-02-28
lines:
  - Plan: Pro (standard) qty: 1 amount: $200
  - Plan: Pro Plus qty: 1 amount: $600  <-- unexpected
Total tokens billed: 1,243,512
```
AtlasOps (customer): Confirming — our dashboard shows only the Pro plan and ~430k tokens. We did do a plan upgrade on 2/18 but it was scheduled for 3/1.
BillingBot: Automated alert: plan-change webhook received for cust_AtlasOps123 at 2026-02-18T15:45:02Z, metadata: {"requested_effective":"2026-03-01"}
Sam (Billing): ok that webhook looks like it recorded. But why would invoice show Pro Plus before 3/1?
Javier (SRE): two quick suspects: 1) metering window mis-applied on month boundary; 2) plan mapping script that annotates usage with plan tiers might have used effective date instead of scheduled date.
Molly (Finance): if invoice is wrong we may need to credit immediately. Can eng confirm root cause before we issue credit?
Elaine (CS): repro steps from AtlasOps: they hit our API for embeddings 2/20-2/28. Dashboard query for token_count by plan: `select sum(tokens) from usage where cust='cust_AtlasOps123' and date between '2026-02-01' and '2026-02-28' group by plan_label;` returned Pro: 430k, Pro Plus: 0.
Javier (SRE): asking infra to tail metering logs for that customer: `curl https://metering.internal/query?customer=cust_AtlasOps123&window=2026-02`. Also checking the plan assignment step in the pipeline.
Javier (SRE): found something: metering service has two assignment passes — realtime annotator and batch summarizer. The realtime annotator saw the 2/18 webhook and annotated subsequent events with `planned_tier=pro_plus` due to a bug where `effective_date` and `scheduled_date` got swapped. Batch summarizer was supposed to re-resolve scheduled semantics but a recent deploy changed the precedence.
Sam (Billing): so some events in the invoice aggregation might have adopted planned_tier instead of active_tier? That would explain charged tokens ~1.24M vs dashboard 430k.
Molly (Finance): what's the impact if we re-run aggregation for Feb with corrected precedence? Will invoice change numbers (and how do we handle posted invoice)?
Javier (SRE): technical plan: 1) patch the summarizer precedence logic to use `active_on` timestamp, not `requested_effective`. 2) re-run summarizer for cust_AtlasOps123 for Feb 2026 with corrected mapping. 3) produce diff report. This should drop billed tokens to match dashboard (~430k).
Elaine (CS): AtlasOps — we'll follow up with expected timeline.
AtlasOps (customer): thanks, would like a provisional credit if invoice is already paid.
Sam (Billing): can we issue a provisional credit? We need sign-off from Finance. Molly?
Molly (Finance): provisional credit yes, up to the delta. Please include an audit trail and estimate. I'll approve once we get diff.
Javier (SRE): running re-aggregation now (job id: reagg-1716002100). I'll post results.
BillingBot: Re-aggregation job reagg-1716002100 queued.
Javier (SRE): reagg complete. Diff: billed_tokens_before=1,243,512 billed_tokens_after=438,792 delta_tokens=804,720 delta_amount=$482.83.
Javier (SRE): root cause summary: plan-change webhook handler set `assigned_tier` using `requested_effective` for both annotator and summarizer after last deploy. Batch summarizer precedence was unintentionally reversed. Fix committed in 2f9a1b and rolled out to staging; patch to prod in 30m.
Elaine (CS): Molly, Sam — attaching diff file and recommended provisional credit of $482.83.
Molly (Finance): approved provisional credit $482.83. Please create credit memo and note "pending aggregation audit".
Sam (Billing): created credit memo CM-2026-02-AtlasOps-1 and applied to invoice INV-2026-02-28. Customer notified.
AtlasOps (customer): appreciated — please confirm when full fix is live and that our March scheduled upgrade won't be touched.
Javier (SRE): prod fix deployed. Regression test added to pipeline to assert `active_tier` precedence on summarization.
Elaine (CS): closing loop with AtlasOps: sent message summarizing cause, credit, and prod fix. :white_check_mark:
AtlasOps (customer): thanks everyone, much appreciated.
Molly (Finance): tagging for records: finance#billing-audit-2026-02.
